speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Could you please tell me when these gait and limb ataxia symptoms first started, and have they been getting progressively worse over time?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see, the symptoms are primarily on the right side. Have you experienced any recent headaches, nausea, or episodes of dizziness that accompany these balance issues?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and treatment with natalizumab, I am concerned about the risk of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML). Do you have any additional symptoms such as cognitive changes, visual disturbances, or weakness? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain_with_contrast
